sites.name: The High Voice relay station (V10)
sites.storm: above the cloud: clear, calm, gold light; bare wind-scoured rock; the fewest objects on the road
sites.story: B23 the last entry and the mark; B24/CIN_24 the transmission, the mast up-shot, the held seated shot; CIN_23 (optional) the Keeper at the hut
sites.style: BAZAAR STONE hut (AB walls, flagstone roof), cut sandstone collar and deadmen, brass conduit and plate, iron guys
sites.layout:
road (down 17 %) ====> [collar + MAST] . . . guy -> deadman (ahead-left, 16 m)
        path -> plate (StandPoint) -> door      [HUT 6.2 x 3.2 m, front turned back up the road]
  moss boulder (valley verge)          bench on the valley gable     rock face past the hut
  seated view: east from the collar, empty to the valley; deadmen behind-left and right
sites.notes: Story-owned: the L2 HighVoice actor (mast, crown, beam) and BP_Saskarta_HighVoice (ending hooks) are not placed here. S26 dresses the interior against interior_frame, on the plinth of this set.

editor_steps: python Tools/GameFlow/editor_gate.py acquire --owner LANE_V10   # one editor lane at a time; PIE must be off
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py --no-plot                          # regenerate V10.json offline; exit 0 = no offline violation
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor load --owner LANE_V10       # its own call (WP pinning rule); S26 later runs inside this load
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor survey                      # expect HighVoice (L2) and nothing tagged SD_V10_HighVoice
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py mastcheck                          # read-only: the pillar vs the collar hole (>= 3 cm) and the ground at point 0
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor place --owner LANE_V10      # solids (15 per call), then the ISM hosts
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor settle --owner LANE_V10     # rigid/lie by trace, rest by emulated physics; bear/stack wait for level
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py level --owner LANE_V10             # plinth (Z to clear the ground), collar course 1 + cap, hut on the plinth, roof, shutter
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py doorcheck                          # read-only: the arch opening and the plate on its jamb (PLATE ON_JAMB OK)
if doorcheck printed OVERHANGS or other DOOR_ARGS: python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py --door-w W --door-h H [--plate-y Y]; rerun s26 offline
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py lines --owner LANE_V10             # 3 guys + the conduit + the riser (non-uniform scale, NoCollision)
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor ground --owner LANE_V10     # the decal patches (MI_SD_Ground_* exist: built for S07)
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor matsurvey --owner LANE_V10
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py materials variants                 # _GB copies of any material not yet in setdress_material_map.json
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor material --owner LANE_V10
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py hooks --owner LANE_V10 --mark      # only once BP_Saskarta_HighVoice is placed (task ENDING 6c); else it says so
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor check2 --owner LANE_V10     # must print violations=0 (walls, cap and roof need the V2 lane bear class)
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor capture --owner LANE_V10    # carrier_a..c, orbit_a..c, contact, high34, far300, seat, mastup
review Saved/Screenshots/SetDressV2/V10_HighVoice/ with the user; fix in this generator, then editor replace <ids>, level, lines, check2
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor save --owner LANE_V10       # refuses while check2 is stale or has violations (level/lines mark it stale)
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py hooks-save --owner LANE_V10        # the ending actor package; refuses if the file is read-only on disk
S26 (s26_high_voice_hut.py) now, inside this load: place .. save (docs/world/story_sets/RUNBOOK.md)
python Tools/World/story_sets/v10_high_voice.py editor unload --owner LANE_V10
python Tools/GameFlow/editor_gate.py release --owner LANE_V10; commit the new external actor packages by pathspec
then task ENDING step 7: probe-ending reads Plate/StandPoint/SeatPoint from the placed actor; re-emit CIN_24 and CIN_23
